name: Navigation menu
purpose: The main site navigation, with panels that open from the top bar. Each item is a link or a trigger that opens a group of links.

notFor.when: The items are commands, not links.
The items change a view on the same page.

basis.note: Behaviors come from the Notion UI SDK inventory (2026-11-21). The support tag on each one was checked against the source on the checked date.

anatomy.note: The nav landmark. It sets the delays and the direction.
A link. Pass active for the current page.
The shared panel frame. vois-navigation-menu renders it.
The marker under the hovered trigger. vois-navigation-menu does not use it.

behaviors.text: Pointing at a trigger opens its panel after a short delay. Moving to the next trigger switches with no delay.
behaviors.note: Hover is always on. There is no click-only mode.

behaviors.text: Clicking a trigger toggles its panel, and a click closes a panel that hover opened.
behaviors.evidence: navigation-menu.tsx: trigger click toggles; pointer enter does not reopen a panel closed by click or Escape

behaviors.text: The menu can be set to open on click only.
behaviors.evidence: navigation-menu.tsx: trigger pointer enter and move always open
behaviors.note: Touch screens work because tap triggers click. Desktop users always get hover.

behaviors.text: Choosing a link closes the panel. A modified click, such as Ctrl or Shift, leaves it open.
behaviors.evidence: navigation-menu.tsx: Link click dispatches a dismiss unless onSelect calls preventDefault or event.metaKey is set
behaviors.note: Only the Cmd key keeps it open. Ctrl and Shift close it. Call preventDefault in onSelect to change that.

behaviors.text: The panels do not move off screen near the edge of the window.
behaviors.evidence: navigation-menu.tsx: there is no collision flip or shift
behaviors.note: A panel near the edge can overflow. Place the viewport yourself.

behaviors.text: Closed panels stay in the page for search and for find in page.
behaviors.evidence: navigation-menu.tsx: Content supports forceMount through Presence
behaviors.note: Mount only what you need. A big hidden menu costs load time.

behaviors.text: Arrow Down on a trigger opens its panel and moves focus into it. Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger.
behaviors.evidence: navigation-menu.tsx: entry key is ArrowDown for horizontal; Escape sets wasEscapeCloseRef and focus returns to the trigger

behaviors.text: Arrow Left and Right move between triggers. Home and End go to the first and last. The arrows do not wrap.
behaviors.evidence: navigation-menu.tsx: FocusGroupItem handles Home, End and the arrows, and slices the list instead of wrapping
behaviors.note: The Menubar wraps. This one stops at the ends.

behaviors.text: Tab moves from the trigger into its open panel, then on to the next trigger.
behaviors.evidence: navigation-menu.tsx lines 1051 to 1070: hidden focus proxies keep the tab order between trigger and content

behaviors.text: The link for the current page is marked and shown as current.
behaviors.evidence: navigation-menu.tsx: Link active sets data-active and aria-current page; vois-navigation-menu passes it through
behaviors.note: The Indicator does not follow the current page. It shows only for the hovered or open trigger.

behaviors.text: The open item can be controlled.
behaviors.evidence: navigation-menu.tsx: Root takes value, defaultValue and onValueChange

behaviors.text: A sub menu nests inside a panel.
behaviors.evidence: navigation-menu.tsx: NavigationMenu.Sub renders a div, not a nav
behaviors.note: This avoids a second navigation landmark.

behaviors.text: The panel opens in a direction that matches the move, so it slides from the side you came from.
behaviors.evidence: navigation-menu.tsx: Content sets data-motion to from-start, from-end, to-start or to-end
behaviors.note: Style it with the data-motion attribute. It stops under reduced motion.

behaviors.text: The menu is a navigation landmark with a label. The default label is Main.
behaviors.evidence: navigation-menu.tsx: Root renders a nav with aria-label Main
behaviors.note: Change it when the page has more than one navigation.

behaviors.text: An icon-only link has an accessible name.
behaviors.note: Radix gives no warning for an icon-only link. Add aria-label yourself.

behaviors.text: Right to left languages swap the arrows, and chevrons and arrows flip.
behaviors.note: dir is passed down, but icons do not flip by themselves.

mistakes.text: Do not make an icon-only link without a name. Nothing warns you.
Do not put padding on the Content for spacing. The viewport sizes to the content, so put it on an inner wrapper.
Do not use it for commands. It is for links. Use Menubar for commands.
